requirements.requirement: The system must define a typed UI schema object for malpractice display including fields: status, case_count, last_incident_date, state_board_url, and score_contribution.
The system must restrict the status field to only three allowed enum values: clean, flagged, or unknown.
The system must allow case_count to be nullable or omitted without causing schema validation failure.
The system must allow last_incident_date to be nullable or omitted without causing schema validation failure.
The system must require state_board_url to be a valid absolute URL string when present.
The system must represent score_contribution as a numeric value or formatted string compatible with existing score display conventions.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable into markdown-safe text without introducing unsafe characters or breaking rendering in MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must ensure all string fields in the schema are escaped or sanitized to prevent markdown injection or rendering corruption.
The system must define the schema in a format directly consumable by MessageBubble.tsx without requiring transformation outside the component.
The system must ensure that missing optional fields do not prevent rendering of the malpractice section in the UI.
The system must default status to unknown when no malpractice data is provided from the backend.
The system must reject schema objects containing fields outside the defined contract.
The system must handle invalid state_board_url values by omitting the link from the rendered output rather than failing.
The system must handle improperly formatted last_incident_date values by treating them as null and continuing rendering.
The system must ensure the schema structure is consistent across all provider responses to enable deterministic UI rendering.
